title: Find the Point of Tangency
text:
Substitute $x = 2$ into the original equation to find $y$:

$y = (2)^3 - 2(2)^2 + 2$

$y = 8 - 8 + 2 = 2$

So the point of tangency is $(2, 2)$

title: Use Point-Gradient Form
text:
The point-gradient form is: $y - y_1 = m(x - x_1)$

With $m = 5$ and point $(2, 2)$:

$y - 2 = 5(x - 2)$

$y - 2 = 5x - 10$

title: Simplify to Standard Form
text:
$y = 5x - 10 + 2$

$y = 5x - 8$

The equation of the tangent is $y = 5x - 8$
